basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer living in Austin, Texas. I have a passion for gaming, particularly rhythm games like Beat Saber. I spend my evenings immersed in VR worlds. When I'm not coding or gaming, I enjoy hiking in the nearby hills and experimenting with new recipes. I'm currently single and often online during late nights and weekends. I work remotely, which allows me the flexibility to jump into Reddit discussions throughout the day.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over 6 years. My interest in VR and gaming led me to self-teach the nuances of modding and customizing gaming experiences. I frequently keep up with the latest technology trends and am well-versed in software development practices.
